queries.query: अंबाला हरियाणा भू नक्शा cadastral map land records आधिकारिक नक्शा
queries.scope: Find district/city first-party land record and parcel-map services; determine anonymous geometry access.
queries.result: Official Ambala district land-record service routes to Haryana Jamabandi. Official Haryana DULBGIS describes property and ward/colony mapping across municipal bodies, but the portal exposes mobile/OTP sign-in; the separate HARSAC EODB land-record app also requires public-login OTP. No public full polygon was queried.

officialSources.observation: District Ambala says the Haryana Revenue Department portal provides land record, mutation and Jamabandi lookup.
ULB portal says properties, wards/colonies and municipal boundaries are mapped for all Haryana municipalities; disclaimer says data are display-only; login screen requests mobile/OTP.
HARSAC page advertises digital cadastral land records; map access is behind mobile/OTP public-login workflow.
